C0318.title: Tang XX Used 'Changyou Registration Bot' for Mass Game Account Creation
C0318.summary: Defendant Tang XX purchased a registration bot and its source code online, then modified it into 'Changyou Registration Bot.exe'. The software automatically generated registration details and obtained phone numbers and verification codes via third-party code-receiving platforms to mass-register game accounts. The court adjudicated the case accordingly.
